How to Apply to the Graduate Program
US Applicants
Applications for our graduate program are due on January 15 for fall applications and August 25 for spring applications. We will notify all applicants once an admission decision has been made.
The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is no longer a prerequisite for admission.
Apply to our Graduate Program (MS and PhD)
All applications must adhere to the following requirements:
Minimum qualifications as defined by the Graduate School.
Transcripts (official or unofficial).
Reason Statement.
This document is typically one or two pages long and should provide your motivation, goals for pursuing graduate study, specific interests, background, and relevant academic awards or honors. Clearly state your interest in a particular area of chemistry and potential research groups.
Three email addresses for recommendation letters.
Our system will automatically send requests for recommendation letters. Please inform your recommenders that they must submit the letter as a PDF file with original letterhead and signature.
$75 application fee.
This fee is non-refundable and cannot be waived.
Please check the status of your application regularly and refer to our frequently asked questions about applying. If you have any further questions, don’t hesitate to contact our Graduate Program Coordinator.
International Applicants
International applicants must also provide the following:
Proof of English Proficiency.
UWM accepts various forms of evidence of English proficiency, such as English proficiency tests. If you take an English proficiency test, you must meet the requirements for Full Admission and Teaching Assistants to be considered for admission.
An official English translation accompanying any transcript submitted in the native language.
The International Admissions page of the Center for International Education offers more details about these requirements.
